reference.scope: Stage4J9: exact-FVF converted declaration cache with one private cache hold,no public resource/device pin. Live/recorded SetFVF retains cached declaration storage; GetVertexDeclaration exposes real same-object views,public0->1/1->0 revives/drops one parent pin. Zero FVF is successful no-op. Direct binding of converted declaration preserves its FVF association. Reset clears current binding but retains cached identities/layouts; final device cleanup detaches cache flags and drains private holds. Cache teardown is idempotent with public views alive and lookup can reattach ownership without replacing identity. Actual native methods plus real shared pure FVF decoder:116928 checks,128 final-owner profiles,8192 cached switches,16384 public-zero revivals,six independent layouts,record/capture/apply,reset-style preservation,atomic OOM/emitter failure and cache cleanup.14 strict assertion mutants,three old actual SetFVF/rebind/owned-cleanup controls,ASAN/UBSAN;retained resource/root/stream graphs and callbacks. XP performs768 loop switches/revivals,778 complete layout/sentinel rounds,six cached and one user declaration. Zero preserves converted and user identity; direct resource binding and recorded/captured converted declarations render correctly; one public view survives Reset and returns unchanged identity,second Reset retires user declaration,last device release retires six cache objects. Seven declaration creates/destroys,777 exact inline FVFs,four resource declarations,four UP draws,one Clear,two successful Resets,five simulated transport replies; dual GPU independently validates320 pixels and empty maps before genuine owner release. Cached layouts include XYZ,XYZRHW,NORMAL-only,transformed diffuse,and normal/texture and specular/texture combinations; only valid transformed20/32-byte layouts are drawn. User-declaration reverse FVF inference,nonNULL stream bounds/unaligned hardware differences,failed-UP cleanup,D3D8,arbitrary callbacks/thread/loss/full Reset/format/MSAA/fullscreen/multi-buffer/wrapper conversion,native HAL,games/FPS and overall stages4/5/6 remain open.
